children: The National Bank of Egypt (NBE) has received preliminary approval from the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) to acquire Banque Misr’s branch network in the Emirates.
The branches are targeted by a proposal from the US Treasury Department, which in August moved to restrict their access to correspondent banking services with US financial institutions.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Egypt’s NBE moves to take over Banque Misr’s UAE branches amid US sanctions scrutiny
